سَبْتَآءُ A [desert such as is termed] صَحْرَآء: (AZ, K:) or أَرْضٌ سَبْتَآءُ is like صَحْرَآءُ: or a land in which are no trees: (M:) and i. q. ↓ مَسْبُوتَةٌ [i. e. a bare land; as though shorn of its herbage]: (TA:) pl. سَبَاتِىُّ. (M.) ―
-b2- Also, [in like manner] a fem. epithet, Having spreading, or expanded, ears, whether long or short. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
